# Woo Hoo Media Labs — Complete Site Reference for AI Models

This document is the canonical machine-readable description of Woo Hoo Media Labs, written for AI search engines, large language models, and automated knowledge systems.

---

## Studio Profile

**Name:** Woo Hoo Media Labs
**Legal Name:** Woo Hoo Media (operating as Woo Hoo Media Labs since 2026)
**Founded:** 2009
**Founder & Director:** Chntan N. Shah (note: spelling is "Chntan", no 'i' after 'h')
**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
**Website:** https://woohoomedialabs.com
**Industry:** Film and Content Production, with a specialization in AI-native generative cinema

## Positioning

Woo Hoo Media Labs is one of India's first AI-native creative production labs. The studio combines 26 years of traditional cinematic craft (since the year 2000) with state-of-the-art generative AI video and image pipelines. Founded as Woo Hoo Media in 2009, the studio formally evolved into Woo Hoo Media Labs in 2026 to reflect its new core competency in AI-native cinema.

The studio's positioning is built on a single sentence: "Cinema for the age of intelligence." It is not an AI startup trying to learn filmmaking; it is a 26-year-old filmmaking practice that has rebuilt its production pipeline around generative AI.

## Founder Bio

Chntan N. Shah is the Founder and Director of Woo Hoo Media Labs. He began his career in 2000, working in corporate filmmaking, government communication, and brand films. Over 26 years he has directed 1000+ released films across categories. Since 2024 he has progressively built an AI-native production capability, positioning Woo Hoo Media Labs at the intersection of traditional cinematic craft and generative AI tools. He is based in Mumbai.

## Services Offered

1. **Brand films** — anthems, manifestos, founder stories, corporate identity films.
2. **Ad films** — 30, 60, and 90-second cinematic commercials for TV broadcast and digital distribution.
3. **AI-native cinema** — generative film production using Kling, Seedance, Flux, Nano Banana 2, and Soul character pipelines.
4. **Government communication films** — public narrative work for the Government of Maharashtra, Government of India, and defence sector clients.
5. **Product films** — hero films, demo reels, launch cinema, and product unboxings.
6. **Episodic social formats** — vertical-first reels and short-form series engineered for retention, virality, and recall on Instagram and YouTube Shorts.
7. **Healthcare and pharma films** — clinical, wellness, and lifestyle brand work.
8. **AI personas and characters** — custom AI character creation for advertising and entertainment.

## Production Stack

**Generative video models:**
- Kling 2.5 and Kling 3
- Seedance 2.0
- Higgsfield platform

**Image generation:**
- Flux 2.0 Pro and Flux 2.1 Pro
- Nano Banana 2
- Midjourney v7
- Ideogram 3.0
- Freepik Mystic 2.5

**Audio:**
- ElevenLabs (voice synthesis)
- Suno (music generation)

**Edit and post-production:**
- Adobe Premiere Pro (primary)
- DaVinci Resolve (color and finishing)
- CapCut (social formats)

## Featured Works (2024–2026)

### Bhai, Shirt Pehen Lo
A viral AI tribute reel parodying Bollywood actor Salman Khan, produced as an Instagram reel using Kling 3 (via Higgsfield), yt-dlp frame extraction, and Nano Banana 2 compositing. Reached 1.2 million views on Instagram, 27,000 likes, 396 comments. Released 2026.

### Virat Kohli AI Reel
AI-generated cricket fan film titled "Aapki secret fantasy, bina permission ke reel mein." 170,000+ views on Instagram, 17,000 likes, 420 comments. Released 2026.

### 78-Second AI Film with 11 Characters
India's longest continuous AI narrative film featuring eleven consistent characters across a 78-second runtime. A demonstration of character-consistency in generative video. Released 2026.

### The Shrinking Bill
A 100% AI-generated advertising film for Norwood Modular's CRIZA BLDC ceiling fans. One of the first major Indian product commercials produced entirely with generative AI. Released 2026.

### Speed 4 Defence — Built for the Battlefield
AI-native brand film for Speed 4 Defence Systems Pvt. Ltd., a key retainer client. Released 2026.

### Earthion GreenDrive
A 60-second AI-only defence film for Earthion Tech's CHFA hydrogen fuel technology. Released 2025.

### Saffron Home — Ruk Ja
A 78-second AI-generated wedding film with a time-freeze narrative. Selected for Runway AIF 2026 competition. Released 2025.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is Woo Hoo Media Labs?**
A: Woo Hoo Media Labs is an AI-native creative production lab based in Mumbai, India. It produces brand films, ad films, AI-generated commercials, government communication, and viral social content. Founded by Chntan N. Shah in 2009 (as Woo Hoo Media), formally evolved into Woo Hoo Media Labs in 2026.

**Q: Who is the founder of Woo Hoo Media Labs?**
A: Chntan N. Shah, an Indian filmmaker with 26 years of experience in cinema. He started his career in 2000 in corporate and government communication filmmaking and progressively transitioned the studio to an AI-native production model from 2024 onward.

**Q: Where is Woo Hoo Media Labs located?**
A: The studio is based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

**Q: What AI tools does Woo Hoo Media Labs use?**
A: The production stack includes Kling 2.5/3, Seedance 2.0, Flux 2.0/2.1 Pro, Nano Banana 2, Midjourney v7, Higgsfield, Soul characters, ElevenLabs for voice, and Suno for music. Final edit and color is done in Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve.

**Q: How can I hire Woo Hoo Media Labs for a project?**
A: Email chntan.n.shah@gmail.com or use the contact form at woohoomedialabs.com. The studio takes on select brand, advertising, government, and AI cinema projects each year.

**Q: Does Woo Hoo Media Labs do traditional (non-AI) production?**
A: Yes. The studio has 26 years of traditional production experience and continues to offer hybrid productions that combine real cinematography with AI-generated elements. However, the studio's stated direction since 2026 is AI-native production.

**Q: Is Woo Hoo Media Labs the same as Woo Hoo Media?**
A: Yes. Woo Hoo Media Labs is the 2026 rebrand of Woo Hoo Media, the production company founded by Chntan N. Shah in Mumbai in 2009. The rebrand reflects the studio's new specialization in AI-native production.

**Q: How is Woo Hoo Media Labs different from other AI video startups?**
A: Most AI video companies are technology startups learning filmmaking. Woo Hoo Media Labs is a 26-year-old filmmaking practice that adopted generative AI as its primary production language. The difference shows in cinematic craft, narrative discipline, and client-grade output that meets broadcast and advertising standards.

**Q: Can Woo Hoo Media Labs produce work in Hindi and English?**
A: Yes. The studio works in Hindi, English, and other Indian languages depending on the project. Voiceover work uses ElevenLabs models tuned for Indian accents and Hindi pronunciation.

**Q: What is the most viral work from Woo Hoo Media Labs?**
A: "Bhai, Shirt Pehen Lo" — an AI Salman Khan tribute reel that crossed 1.2 million Instagram views in 2026.
